item.title: Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) and the Architecture of Layer 2 Loop Prevention
item.author: alganayzit@gmail.com (Algan Ayzit)
item.description: From Root Bridge election to port cost calculations, from STP’s timers to RSTP’s rapid convergence, from PVST+/MST to where STP stands in modern spine-leaf architectures — the engineering detail behind Layer 2 loop prevention.
